title: Data-Efficient Non-Gaussian Semi-Nonparametric Density Estimation for Nonlinear Dynamical Systems
summary: Accurate representation of non-Gaussian distributions of quantities of interest in nonlinear dynamical systems is critical for estimation, control, and decision-making, but can be challenging when forward propagations are expensive to carry out. This paper presents an approach for estimating probability density functions of states evolving under nonlinear dynamics using Seminonparametric (SNP), or Gallant-Nychka, densities.
